parameters.query:
SELECT c.*
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) AS x
CROSS JOIN LATERAL contexto_turno(p->>'session_id', (p->>'bloqueio')::integer, (p->>'mensagens')::integer,
                                  'Europe/Lisbon', p->>'canal') AS c
